title: Next Generation Sequencing and RNA-Seq Characterization of Adipose Tissue in Nile Crocodile
author: Odunayo I Azeez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.69thh6n
materials: RNA Quality Assurance Before sample preparation, total RNA quality was assessed using Biotek Nanodrop Powerwave XS 2 Microplate Spectrophotometer at the wavelength of 260 and 280 nm, 260/280 ratios ranging from 1.065 to 1.661 at concentrations of 1000 ng/μl and above. Integrity and quality of selected samples were then evaluated on Qubit 3.0 Fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA), which measures only RNA concentration directly using target-specific fluorescent dye. Samples with RNA concentration greater than 1 μg/ μL without genomic DNA contaminants were considered adequate for the downstream analysis according to Pfaffl et al. (2008).

Five μl of rRNA binding buffer was added followed by 5 μl of rRNA removal mix gold. This was then incubated in the thermocycler, set at 68 oC for 5 min after which it was removed and allowed to stand at room temperature for 1 min.
The new plate and the content were then incubated in the thermocycler at 94oC for 8 min and 4oC hold before it was centrifuged briefly.

steps.title: Extract Total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from adipose tissue or liver samples using TRIzol reagent.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize 100 mg of sample in 900 μl of Trizol homogenizing buffer using a Precelleys 24® homogenizer.
Transfer homogenate to 1.5 ml centrifuge tubes and pipette 200 μl into a new tube.
Add 800 μl of Trizol reagent to the 200 μl homogenate and mix.
Add 200 μl of chloroform, allow to stand at room temperature for 10 mins for phase separation, then centrifuge at 12,000 xg for 10 min at 4 °C.
Transfer the clear supernatant to another tube, add 200 μl of Isopropanol, and store at -20 °C for 12 hours.
Centrifuge at 12,000 xg for 15 mins at 4 °C and remove the supernatant.
Wash the RNA by adding 500 μl of 70% ethanol, then centrifuge at 16,000 g for 5-10 mins.
Gently remove ethanol and leave tubes in the hood for 10 mins to evaporate.
Dissolve the RNA pellet in 20 μl of RNAse free water.

steps.title: Quantify and Quality Check RNA
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration and quality of the extracted total RNA.

substeps.instruction: Use a Biotek Nanodrop Powerwave XS 2 Microplate Spectrophotometer to determine optical density.
Ensure total RNA concentration is 1000 ng/μl or above for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Deplete Ribosomal RNA (rRNA)
steps.instruction: Remove ribosomal RNA using the Illumina rRNA removal mix gold and Ribo-Zero beads.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 1 μl of total RNA (at 1 μg/μl) with nuclease free water up to 10 μl on a 0.3 ml, 96 well PCR plate.
Transfer the mixture to a fresh plate containing 35 μl of rRNA removal beads; mix thoroughly.
Place on a magnetic plate for 1 min at room temperature, transfer supernatant to a fresh PCR plate, and repeat until all beads are removed.
Add 99 μl of RNAClean XP beads, incubate at room temperature for 15 min, then place on a magnetic plate for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and wash beads with 200 μl of 70% ethanol; incubate for 1 min at room temperature and remove supernatant.
Dry the RCP plate on the magnetic plate for 15 min.
Add 11 μl of elution buffer, mix by pipetting, incubate at room temperature for 2 mins, then place on the magnetic plate for 5 mins.
Transfer 8.5 μl of supernatant to a Depleted RNA Fragment Plate (DFP) and add 8.5 μl each of elute, primer, and fragment high mix buffers.

steps.title: Synthesize First-Strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize first-strand cDNA from rRNA-depleted RNA using Superscript II and Actinomycin D (Act D).

substeps.instruction: Prepare Act D mix by adding Superscript II to Act D at a ratio of 1 μl Superscript II to 9 μl Act D.
Add 8 μl of the first strand mix to the DFP plate.
Incubate with the lid preheated to 100 °C using the following cycle: 25 °C for 10 mins, 42 °C for 15 min, 70 °C for 15 mins, and hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Synthesize Second-Strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize double-stranded cDNA by replacing the RNA template with dUTP in place of dTTP.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 μl of resuspension buffer to each well of the DFP plate.
Add 20 μl of second strand marking master mix and mix thoroughly.
Incubate at 16 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Purify Double-Stranded cDNA
steps.instruction: Clean up the double-stranded cDNA using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 90 μl of AMPure XP beads to 50 μl of ds-cDNA in the DFP plate and incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Place on a magnetic plate for 5 mins and remove the supernatant.
Wash twice with 200 μl of 80% ethanol and dry on the magnetic plate.
Add 17.5 μl of resuspension buffer, seal, and shake on a microplate shaker at 1800 rpm for 2 mins.
Place on the magnetic stand for 5 min and pipette 15 μl of the ds-cDNA supernatant into a new plate.

steps.title: Perform A-Tailing and Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Incorporate Adenylate 3’ adapters and ligate indexed adapters to the ds-cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 12.5 μl of A tailing mix (1 μl A tailing control and 99 μl resuspension buffer), shake at 1800 rpm for 2 mins, centrifuge at 280 xg for 1 min, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 mins.
Add 2.5 μl of Ligation mix, mix well, and incubate at 30 °C for 10 min.
Add 5 μl of stop ligation buffer.
Clean up the plate using AMPure XP beads and wash with 80% ethanol.
Dry the ethanol and add resuspension buffer; transfer 20 μl of the supernatant containing ligated ds-cDNA into a fresh PCR plate.

steps.title: Enrich cDNA Library via PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the ligated ds-DNA fragments using PCR.

substeps.instruction: Set PCR lid to 100 °C.
Perform initial denaturation at 98 °C for 30 secs.
Run 15 cycles of: 98 °C for 10 secs, 60 °C for 30 secs, 72 °C for 30 secs.
Final extension at 72 °C for 5 mins and hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Sequence the Transcriptome
steps.instruction: Perform dual indexed paired-end sequencing on an Illumina Hiseq 2500.

substeps.instruction: Use the Illumina Hiseq SBS v4 master mix kit.
Load Incorporation Reagent Master mix (IRM), Universal Scan mix (USM), Cleavage Reagent mix (CRM), high salt buffer, and incorporation/cleavage buffers onto the loading rack.
Set the instrument for a 250 cycle run.

steps.title: Process and Assemble Reads
steps.instruction: Trim reads and perform de novo transcriptome assembly using a UNIX shell environment.

substeps.instruction: Trim and quality filter fasta/fastq files using Trimmomatic-0.35 with the command: `java -jar trimmomatic-0.35.jar PE -phred33 input_forward.fq.gz input_reverse.fq.gz output_forward_paired.fq.gz output_forward_unpaired.fq.gz output_reverse_paired.fq.gz output_reverse_unpaired.fq.gz ILLUMINACLIP:TruSeq3-PE.fa:2:30:10 LEADING:3 TRAILING:3 SLIDINGWINDOW:4:15 MINLEN:36`.

Assemble the transcriptome using Bridger at 25 bp k-mer length with the command: `nohup perl ./Bridger.pl—seqType fq—kmer_length 25 --left ../CrocTR1.fastq—right ../CrocTR2.fastq—SS_lib_type RF—CPU 10 --output Croc &`.

steps.title: Annotate Transcriptome and Predict ORFs
steps.instruction: Identify proteins and predict open reading frames (ORFs).

substeps.instruction: Blast identified transcripts against Crocodylus porosus transcriptome and protein sequences from Uniprot, NCBI Non-redundant (NR), and EMBL-EBI databases.
Perform gene ontology classification using PANTHER GO version 10.
Predict ORFs using Bridger and evaluate them using Transrate v1.0.3.
Identify conserved domains via similarity searches against the Crocodylus niloticus genome database.

steps.title: Analyze Differential Gene Expression
steps.instruction: Determine differential expression levels using Tophat, Cufflinks, and RSEM.

substeps.instruction: Align reads with Tophat 2.1.1 (utilizing Bowtie 2.0) and convert reads to transcripts using Cufflinks.
Prepare reference transcripts using `rsem-prepare-reference` and calculate expression abundance and 95% credibility intervals using `rsem-calculate-expression` via RSEM.
Blast expressed genes (blastx) against SwissProt, TrEMBL (Uniprot), and NCBI NR databases with an E-value cut-off of 1e-5.
Classify genes using PANTHER GO.
Construct a volcano plot (log10P vs log2Fold change) using ggplot2 in R.
Upload differentially expressed genes to the Reactome pathways database for enrichment analysis.

description: Pfaffl M, Fleige S, Riedmaier I. Validation of lab-on-chip capillary electrophoresis systems for total RNA quality and quantity control. Biotechnology & Biotechnological Equipment. 2008;22(3):829-34.
